description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Coastal Retreat!* Recently Renovated* Private Pool and Two Outdoor Courtyards – Relax poolside, lounge in the sunshine, or enjoy dining and grilling outdoors* Pool Can Be Heated (add'l fee)* 4 Complimentary Adult Bikes – Explore Rosemary Beach, 30A, and the surrounding coastal communities* Beach Chairs and Umbrellas Included – Everything you need for relaxing beach days* Private Elevator – Convenient access throughout the home* Top-Floor Refreshment Station – Coffee maker and mini fridge for added convenience* New Extra-Large Samsung Smart TVs and Xbox Series X – Plenty of entertainment for the whole group* Whole-House 6-Stage Water Purification System – Added comfort and convenience throughout the home* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *** Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, pool/spa heater controls, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door and pool area. **Welcome to Stepping Stone Main Home, a luxurious coastal retreat perfectly positioned just steps from 30A and Rosemary Beach! Recently renovated with extensive upgrades and improvements, including a brand-new private elevator, this beautiful home combines sophisticated design, modern conveniences, and plenty of space for an unforgettable beach vacation. Step outside and discover your own private oasis. Stepping Stone features a private pool and two outdoor courtyards, creating the perfect setting for relaxing in the sunshine, grilling, enjoying an al fresco meal, or gathering with family and friends. The pool can also be heated for an additional fee, allowing you to enjoy it throughout the year.Inside, the home features an inviting open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area designed for gathering. The high-end kitchen appliances make preparing meals a breeze, while the spacious living area provides plenty of room for everyone to relax. A brand-new private elevator adds an extra level of convenience, making it easy to access the home's multiple levels. Stepping Stone comfortably sleeps up to 12 guests across four bedrooms. Three bedrooms feature King beds and private ensuite bathrooms, while the spacious bunk room features twin-over-twin bunk beds with pull-out trundles and sleeps up to six guests. The home also features two primary suites, each offering a soaking tub, shower, beautiful views, and a peaceful retreat space. The top floor also features a convenient refreshment station complete with a coffee maker and mini fridge. With its unbeatable location, private pool, luxury upgrades, and proximity to Rosemary Beach and 30A, Stepping Stone Home is the perfect place to relax, reconnect, and enjoy everything the Emerald Coast has to offer.The Bed Setup:2nd Floor: Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed Guest Bunk Bedroom 2: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds with Pull-Out Trundles3rd Floor: Master Bedroom 1: King Bed Master Bedroom 2: King BedArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
